representationNotInterpretation.note: description/representation/physical source remain distinct from semantic target and interpretation authority.

associationBoundary.note: Accepted v0.12 associationBoundary semantics remain an explicit higher-level compatibility capability of v0.13; the original mandatory executable evidence is retained and the legacy interpreter layer does not define the v0.13 foundation alphabet.

exactAnumRooting.baselineStatement: Anum is a Link role; every local Anum begins at R and the exact rooted Anum/question is distinct from its addressed target
exactAnumRooting.note: v0.13 directly requires every local exact sequence/anum context to originate at R.

knowledgeStateSeparation.baselineStatement: UNINTERPRETABLE, understood-but-NOT_FOUND and FOUND(X) are semantically distinct read outcomes
knowledgeStateSeparation.note: v0.13 explicitly retains the accepted distinction between structurally UNINTERPRETABLE input, understood-but-NOT_FOUND, and FOUND(X); executable parity exercises all three outcomes.

resolveMaterializeSeparation.baselineStatement: Resolve is a read-only one-root-cut; exact address materialization and write-authorized target materialization are distinct capabilities
resolveMaterializeSeparation.note: v0.13 retains read-only one-root-cut Resolve, exact-address materialization separate from target materialization, and NOT_FOUND without implicit writes.

targetMaterializationBound.baselineStatement: MATERIALIZE_TARGET removes exactly one leading R hierarchy-wide, preserves remaining indirection and fails closed before target writes on invalid exact evidence
targetMaterializationBound.note: v0.13 retains one hierarchy-wide root cut, preserves remaining Anum indirection, and validates exact evidence before target-side writes.

rootBasisBoundary.baselineStatement: Q and v0.12 STRING/source operations require a structurally valid declared R/O/C/L/U basis with proper O/C relative to R; invalid, collapsed, forged or foreign basis evidence fails closed and write operations perform zero writes
rootBasisBoundary.note: rooted basis and Link-native structural signs are explicitly checked, while the accepted v0.12 basis gate remains retained.

v012StringByteIdentity.baselineStatement: Byte_v012(p) is the exact rooted Anum of bits8(p), not the historical Byte_v09 denotation; grouped byte Anums form the exact STRING Anum
v012StringByteIdentity.note: exact byte identity and allocation-independent structural description are required.

utf8CarrierBoundary.baselineStatement: UTF-8 code-point grouping is a read over exact STRING bytes and does not rewrite STRING carrier topology or grant glyph spelling semantic authority
utf8CarrierBoundary.note: v0.13 retains exact-byte STRING identity and strict read-only UTF-8 interpretation; malformed exact bytes may be UTF-8-uninterpretable, Unicode normalization does not redefine STRING identity, and glyph spelling grants no structural authority.

sourceUseAuthority.baselineStatement: exact STRING source is replayed only against an independently selected V012SourceAuthority: exact Dictionary identity plus exact Grammar/Theory membership Links; raw membership shape is not semantic authority
sourceUseAuthority.note: source/Dictionary/Grammar/fixed-Theory/Rule authority remains explicit and host glyphs have no semantic authority.

formalResultAuthority.baselineStatement: consumer source-to-result replay requires fixed Theory authority, selected finite Act attachments, matching Dictionary/Grammar/Theory, and equality between the source-selected Use and the selected Rule-role binding; candidate self-admission and late unselected ambient attachments do not gain authority
formalResultAuthority.note: semantic result/materialization remains admitted-rule-authorized and fails closed.
